narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty is the bigger treasure, so a jump of thirty is the longest!
<bookmark mark='hop'/>A jump of thirty lands on thirty. But from zero it flies past fourteen.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It misses that treasure, and the jump must land on both.

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>The longest jump that lands on two treasures is the largest number that divides both.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Treasures sit on sixteen and forty. Find the longest jump from zero that lands on both.
